findings.title: Records owned by deactivated users
findings.detail: Farid Haddad still owns 32 accounts, 43 deals, 78 contacts, 308 leads. Workflow alerts to "record owner" on these go nowhere useful.

findings.title: Duplicate leads
findings.detail: 175 groups, 190 records to merge away (6.1% of Leads). Matched on: email 106, company 18, phone 54.

findings.title: Open deals past their closing date
findings.detail: 136 of 375 open deals (36%), worth $3,938,800, still count in this quarter's forecast.

findings.title: Duplicate contacts
findings.detail: 42 groups, 42 records to merge away (2.9% of Contacts). Matched on: email 28, phone 13, company 1.

findings.title: Lead Source split across spelling variants
findings.detail: 25 values in use for what are about 13 sources, plus 7 options nobody uses. A "leads by source" report shows "LinkedIn", "Linkedin" and "Linked In" as three bars.

findings.title: Rules that email on every single edit
findings.detail: "Lead changed - notify owner" (Leads), "Deal changed - notify owner" (Deals): no criteria, repeat on. These use up the daily e-mail allowance and teach people to ignore CRM mail.

findings.title: Active workflow rules that do the same thing twice
findings.detail: "New web lead - notify owner" = "New web lead - notify owner (copy)". Each matching record sends every alert twice.

findings.title: Phone numbers in mixed formats
findings.detail: 6 different formats across 5,880 numbers; 0 are in international (+1...) form. Mixed formats are why phone-based duplicate checks and click-to-call miss.

findings.title: Open leads with no activity in 90+ days
findings.detail: 63% of all leads sit in an open status untouched. 161 were never contacted at all after two weeks.

findings.title: Open deals with no activity in 30+ days
findings.detail: 90% of open deals.

findings.title: Leads that are already contacts
findings.detail: Zoho merges only within a module, so these need converting into the existing contact (or deleting) rather than merging.

findings.title: Deals in stages that are no longer in the pipeline
findings.detail: Id. Decision Makers, Value Proposition: they drop out of pipeline-by-stage reports.

findings.title: Deals at proposal stage or later with no amount
findings.detail: Pipeline value and forecast reports under-count these.

findings.title: Custom fields filled on under 2% of records
findings.detail: Candidates to retire after exporting their values; they clutter layouts and count against the edition's custom-field limit.

findings.title: Active rules waiting for a stage that no longer exists
findings.detail: "Value Proposition stage task"

findings.title: Active webhooks to check
findings.detail: "Push lead to old email tool": POST to mail-sync (retired 2024)

findings.title: Lost deals without a loss reason
findings.detail: 62% of lost deals; "why we lose" reports are mostly blank.

findings.title: Emails with capitals or stray spaces
findings.detail: 47 need trimming/lower-casing, 0 are not valid addresses.

findings.title: Different people sharing info@ / sales@ addresses
findings.detail: Not merged: a shared role address is not the same person. Worth asking for a direct address.

findings.title: Picklist options nobody uses
findings.detail: Contacts.Lead_Source: 7, Leads.Lead_Source: 7, Deals.Lead_Source: 7

findings.title: Rules that are off, never ran, or not run in a year
findings.detail: "Trade show 2022 follow-up", "Test rule do not use", "Contact changed - notify owner", "Value Proposition stage task"

findings.title: Custom fields vs the Professional limit (155/module)
findings.detail: Contacts 3, Leads 11, Deals 2, Accounts 2

findings.title: Active rules vs the Professional limit (40/module)
findings.detail: Leads 7, Contacts 1, Deals 5
